cards.headline: Flick confirms Cubarsí is available for Sabah and could play minutes
cards.summary:
Hansi Flick said on Tuesday in Baku that Pau Cubarsí can play against Sabah. He described the centre-back’s issue as minor and nothing too serious, adding that Cubarsí will be there if needed.

Cubarsí had been managing a minor iliopsoas overload and stayed on the bench against Villarreal. Flick has not decided on the starting line-up. Barça sit fifth in the Champions League league phase on nine points after three wins and one defeat.

cards.headline: Yamal stays in Barcelona with mild right-ankle discomfort and is expected for Deportivo
cards.summary:
Lamine Yamal did not travel to Baku. The club said the 19-year-old has mild discomfort in his right ankle and, as a precaution, will miss Wednesday’s Champions League match.

He played the full 90 minutes in Sunday’s 3-2 comeback win over Villarreal. Flick confirmed the decision was taken on Monday morning and said Yamal will be ready before the weekend. The next league match is the trip to Deportivo on 29 November. Yamal has started all 17 of Barça’s matches this season.

cards.headline: Squad completes first training session in Baku at the Olympic Stadium
cards.summary:
The Barça group trained on Tuesday afternoon at the Baku Olympic Stadium, the venue for Wednesday’s match. Official accounts posted the session start after the long flight from Barcelona.

Yamal remained in Spain. The 22-man travelling party includes Bisiwu on his first senior call-up. Christensen, Espart, Rodri and Bardghji are still out. Kick-off against Sabah is 18:45 Spanish time (21:45 local).

cards.headline: Joan García monitored for right-knee discomfort; club may rest him in Baku
cards.summary:
Mundo Deportivo reported that Joan García finished the Villarreal match with pain in his right knee, the same one that forced him to stop in September. He trained on Tuesday but the discomfort has not fully gone.

Fernando Polo and Ferran Martínez wrote that Flick, the medical staff and the goalkeeper will decide together whether he starts against Sabah or is rested. Livaković and Szczęsny are the alternatives. The issue is described as an oedema that improves with rest rather than a new injury.

cards.headline: Flick says the most important thing is the right attitude against Sabah
cards.summary:
Hansi Flick told the media that Sabah like to have the ball and play football. He said the most important thing for Barça is to match that attitude.

He does not believe motivation will be a problem because it is the Champions League and three points are at stake. Flick also noted that the squad has a lot of matches until the end of the year and that he will try to give everyone minutes. He has not finalised the starting XI.

cards.headline: De Jong says Sabah try to play out from the back and Barça must be sharp
cards.summary:
Frenkie de Jong spoke before the match and said Sabah try to play out from the back. He added that Barça will have to be at their best if they want to beat them.

De Jong has been used at centre-back in recent league games. Flick has praised his availability and willingness to play wherever the team needs him. The Dutchman is in the 22-man squad that travelled to Azerbaijan.

cards.headline: Fermín is available for Sabah; club is appealing the domestic ban
cards.summary:
Fermín López is part of the squad in Baku and can play in the Champions League. His red card against Villarreal was for a domestic competition and does not affect European matches.

He was dismissed from the bench on 74 minutes after protesting to the fourth official. The referee’s report cited repeated use of the phrase “No me jodas”. A two-match suspension would rule him out of Deportivo and the rearranged league game against Atlético on 2 December. The club is expected to appeal for a one-match ban.

cards.headline: Sabah-Barça kicks off at 18:45 CET on Movistar; Barça fifth on nine points
cards.summary:
The match is scheduled for Wednesday 25 November at 18:45 Spanish time (21:45 local) at the Baku Olympic Stadium. In Spain it is available on M+ Liga de Campeones (M60 O115) and LaLiga TV Bar.

Barça are fifth with nine points (three wins, one defeat). Sabah are 31st with three points and are playing their first Champions League campaign. A win would strengthen Barça’s position in the race for a top-eight finish. The trip is the longest European journey in the club’s history.

cards.headline: SPORT says Balde faces a match that could clarify his future under Flick
cards.summary:
Diario SPORT reported that Alejandro Balde faces a match against Sabah that could help clarify Hansi Flick’s plans for the left-back.

Balde has been in and out of the starting side this season. The piece by Carlos Monfort notes that minutes in Baku could give a clearer picture of his role. He is part of the 22-man squad that travelled. The next league match after the return is the visit to Deportivo.

cards.headline: Official accounts post five facts and the training start for Sabah-Barça
cards.summary:
FC Barcelona’s Spanish account published “Los 5 datos que debes saber del Sabah - Barça” and the full viewing guide. The English account posted the training session in Baku and Flick’s comments on Cubarsí and squad management.

The club also reminded supporters that this is the halfway point of the league phase. Barça have scored 14 and conceded six in their first four matches. The posts marked the final preparations before kick-off on Wednesday evening.
